text:
### Customer Data Security  
**Personal Information:**
- Never discuss on phone where customers can hear
- Don't leave documents on desk
- File customer documents in locked cabinet
- Shred documents when no longer needed  
**System Access:**
- Log out when leaving desk
- Never share passwords
- Report suspicious activity immediately
- Lock computer when absent  
---

raw_entities.name: Customer Data Security Obligation
raw_entities.description: Staff must protect customer personal information and system access through physical security, document handling, and access control measures. This includes never discussing customer information in public, securing physical documents, and maintaining system security protocols.
context: Never discuss on phone where customers can hear
File customer documents in locked cabinet
Shred documents when no longer needed

raw_entities.name: System Access Security Obligation
raw_entities.description: Staff must maintain system security by logging out when leaving their desk, never sharing passwords, and locking computers when absent. Suspicious activity must be reported immediately.

raw_entities.name: Suspicious Activity Reporting Obligation
raw_entities.description: Staff must report suspicious activity immediately upon detection. This is a mandatory escalation duty for any security concerns related to system access or data handling.

raw_entities.name: Unattended Customer Documents Left on Desk
raw_entities.description: Customer documents left visible on a desk represent a data protection risk and breach of security protocols. This is a warning sign that physical document security controls are not being followed.

raw_entities.name: Unattended Unlocked Computer
raw_entities.description: An unlocked computer left unattended represents a risk of unauthorized system access and potential data breach. Staff must lock computers when absent to prevent this security concern.

raw_entities.name: Public Discussion of Customer Information
raw_entities.description: Discussing customer information on the phone in a location where customers can overhear represents a confidentiality breach and data protection violation. This is a warning sign of improper information handling.
